name: Calendar
description: Events, tasks, medicines and bills for your household on one month view. Kept on this computer, never synced to an outside calendar.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.add_event: Add an event or appointment to the calendar, once or repeating.
tools.add_task: Add a to-do task with a due date. It shows on the calendar on that day.
tools.add_med: Track a medicine to take: its dose, how often and when.
tools.add_bill: Track a bill to pay: its amount and due date. It shows on the calendar on that day.
tools.list_events: List what is on the calendar: one day, or today and the next few days.
tools.list_tasks: List the to-do tasks: open ones by default, or done ones.
tools.list_meds: List the medicines being tracked and whether each was taken today.
tools.list_bills: List the bills: unpaid ones by default, with the total.
tools.edit_event: Change an event: move it, rename it, or change who, where or how often. Name the event, then only what changes.
tools.edit_task: Change a task: rename it, move its due date, or change who or its priority.
tools.complete_task: Mark a to-do task as done.
tools.delete_event: Delete an event from the calendar.
tools.take_med: Note that a medicine was taken today.
tools.delete_bill: Delete a bill so it is no longer tracked.

add_event: add a dentist appointment on friday at 10am to my calendar
add_task: add taking the bins out to my to-do tasks, due tomorrow
add_med: track my vitamin D medicine, one tablet daily at 8 AM
add_bill: track the electric bill, $84.50, due November 5
list_events: what is on my calendar tomorrow
list_tasks: what tasks are still on my to-do list
edit_event: move the dentist appointment to monday at 2pm
edit_task: change the bins task to be due on saturday
complete_task: I took the bins out, mark that task done
delete_event: delete the dentist appointment from my calendar
delete_task: delete the bins task from my to-do list
take_med: I took my vitamin D today
delete_bill: stop tracking the electric bill, delete it

consent: Calendar keeps your events, tasks, medicines and bills in its own data folder on this computer. Medicines are health details and are labelled so. It does not use the internet and never syncs to an outside calendar.
